title: NBA Jam: Tournament Edition
overview:
Your state-of-the-art system demands a state-of-the-art NBA Jam TE - and this is it! Arcade-quality player scaling! Updated player rosters! Actual player heads! Want more? We've got all-new secret characters! Monster-jamming stereo music and authentic arcade sound F/X - including voice calls for individual players! NBA Jam TE... pump it up!

Features
- Player scaling just like the arcade
- Incredible stereo sound
- Baby, Giant and Big Head modes
- Secret players and codes
- Bigger players
- Over 120 NBA stars
- 9 point shots from the Hot Spots
- Super Jam Power-ups
- Updated player roster
- Rookie and All-Star teams
- 3-5 players per team
- Same team match-ups
- Substitutions after every quarter
- Tournament mode
- 5-speed juice mode
- Injuries and fatigue factor
- 8 player attributes
- Auto save with memory cartridge

Over 120 NBA Stars - Rookie and All-Star Teams
